headline: Oh Se-hoon on President Lee's 'Prepare for Home Price Crash': 'Stunned by the Sense of Reality'
summary: Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon criticized President Lee Jae-myung's remark about the possibility of a housing price crash, saying the approach to real estate issues was wrong from the start.
why: South Korea's household wealth and bank lending are closely tied to apartment prices, so official comments on housing draw investor attention.
